definitions.ask: Should the install offer to sync a mismatched login keychain password in place?
definitions.why: Bryan syncs once himself; an installer should not change a keychain password

choices.label: Explain the mismatch, offer a one-run unlock, and print the one-time sync command
Ask [y/N] to run security set-keychain-password, then fall back to the one-run unlock

definitions.ask: Should the install read loginwindow's unified log to confirm the mismatch before naming it?
definitions.why: The last fix guessed wrong; the log line is definitive and costs nothing on success

choices.label: Confirm the mismatch from loginwindow's last keychain unlock; ~3 s, only after a failed probe
Never read the log; always word the mismatch as the likely cause
